phenotypePlain.Poor Metabolizer: Your body processes these medicines slowly.
phenotypePlain.Intermediate Metabolizer: Your body processes these medicines a bit slowly.
phenotypePlain.Normal Metabolizer: Your body processes these medicines at the usual pace.
phenotypePlain.Rapid Metabolizer: Your body processes these medicines a bit fast.
phenotypePlain.Ultrarapid Metabolizer: Your body processes these medicines very fast.

copy.proto: Research prototype — not for clinical use.
copy.otcSub: Type a brand or ingredient name for an instant offline check against your profile (mock product list).
copy.otcIdle: Type any non-prescription medicine name to see its result immediately for this profile.
copy.otcNoGuidelineBody: No CPIC gene guideline applies to this medicine. Normal label advice still applies.
copy.otcNormalGuidelineBody: Based on {gene} ({phenotype}), CPIC points to standard label dosing. Normal label advice still applies.
copy.otcAskGuidelineBody: Based on {gene} ({phenotype}), a pharmacist should review dose or duration before you buy.
copy.otcStopGuidelineBody: Based on {gene} ({phenotype}), avoid taking this medicine without your doctor.
copy.otcNotAssessedBody: {gene}: copy number not assessed by this test — no result reported. Ask the pharmacist before buying.
copy.otcMissingGeneBody: This medicine depends on {gene}, which is not included in this demo profile. Ask the pharmacist before buying.
copy.otcNotFoundTitle: Not in our list — ask the pharmacist
copy.otcNotFoundBody: Could not find "{query}" in our offline demo list. Ask the pharmacist to check its active ingredients against your Passport.
copy.otcOfflineNote: Runs locally with no network · Looked up from CPIC table only.
copy.myGenesSub: These results show how your body handles certain medicines.
copy.myMedsSub: Medicines you already take can temporarily shift how a gene acts.
copy.noMeds: No current medicines recorded in this demo profile.
copy.medsListFull: Your card holds up to 4 medicines. Remove one before adding another, and tell the pharmacist about the rest.
copy.profileNotGermline: This profile is not from an inherited (germline) sample, so the Passport cannot show it.
copy.medsAddSub: Saved on this device only (demo data) and re-checks your genes offline.
copy.otcInhibitorHitBody: This medicine ({ingredient}) is a {strength} {gene} inhibitor and may affect your current medicine ({meds}). Ask the pharmacist before buying.
copy.genePhenoconversionLine: Your genes: {genetic} · Right now you act like: {acting}, because of {causes}.
copy.geneMayBeAffected: Your genes: {genetic} · May be affected by {causes}.
copy.pharmacistSub: Large-text view of your genetic and acting-like results, current medicines, and QR.
copy.pharmacistQrNeedPin: Enter a 6-digit PIN to show your encrypted QR card.
copy.pharmacistScaleLegend: Hollow ring = your genes · Solid needle = acting like today
copy.statusStop: Do not take without your doctor
copy.statusNone: No gene guidance for your profile
copy.notAssessedBody: Copy number not assessed by this test — no result reported. This is not a reassurance.
copy.phenoconversionLine: Genetic result: {genetic} · Acting like: {acting} because of {causes}
copy.readAloudUnavailable: Read-aloud unavailable: no ar-SA voice on this device.
copy.caregiverNote: Viewing as a family member — profile switching and PIN edits are locked.
copy.doctorSub: Show this screen to any prescriber or pharmacist before starting a new medicine.
copy.doctorNoDrugs: No drug guidance rows matched for this gene in the current table.
copy.doctorFooter: Advises, does not prescribe · Recommendations looked up from CPIC table only.
copy.outsideCallNote: Mock outside-call result for copy-number demonstration.
copy.qrSub: Carries your compressed gene summary encrypted with a PIN — never a URL.
copy.qrPinHonesty: The PIN stops casual scanning only; a copied QR can be brute-forced offline.
copy.qrDecodedFail: Could not decode with this PIN.
copy.qrPinPrompt: Choose your PIN to show your card. We never store or send it.
copy.qrReissueNote: Each new card is encrypted afresh. Old cards still open with their old PIN and cannot be cancelled, because they work offline. Destroy them yourself.
copy.qrEmergencyToggle: Add an emergency line readable without the PIN
copy.qrEmergencyLabel: Emergency line (anyone who scans the card sees it)
copy.qrEmergencyHint: Write only what you want everyone to see. The full record is at the hospital.
copy.qrPinBrute: A 6-digit PIN can be guessed on another device if the QR is copied. The card holds gene results only, never your genome or your name.
copy.qrPinErrSix: The PIN must be exactly 6 digits.
copy.qrPinErrMatch: The two PINs do not match. Type it again.
copy.printSub: Wallet-sized ID-1 card (85.60 × 53.98 mm) with no name or result on the face, plus a large-type A6 fold-out for elders.
copy.printRequiresPin: Choose a 6-digit PIN and press "Make my card" above to prepare the encrypted printable card.
copy.printId1Caption: Card front (85.60 × 53.98 mm, ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1) — no name, no ID number, no result.
copy.printA6Caption: A6 fold-out (105 × 148 mm) in large-type plain language for elders.
copy.id1PinEn: Ask the holder for the PIN
copy.id1ProtoEn: Research prototype — not for clinical use
copy.foldoutReminder: Tell your doctor or pharmacist before any new medicine.
copy.noPatientData: Runs on synthetic and GeT-RM reference data; no patient data was used.

scan.proto: Research prototype — not for clinical use.
scan.title: Meyar scan-side reader (offline)
scan.subtitle: Scan the patient QR card with the camera, then enter their PIN to decrypt locally.
scan.camReady: Point the camera at the patient QR card.
scan.camError: Camera unavailable — scan an image file or paste the QR payload below.
scan.qrInvalid: Scanned text is not a valid Meyar QR envelope.
scan.pinSub: Decryption runs locally on this device with zero network calls.
scan.pinHonesty: The PIN stops casual scanning only; a copied QR can be brute-forced offline.
scan.pinError: Could not decrypt with this PIN — ask the patient and try again.
scan.betterMatch: Better matched for this patient's genes:
scan.notAssessedFoot: Copy number not assessed — no result reported
scan.holderLine: Meyar Medication Passport — ask the card holder for the PIN.
scan.holderNote: Until the PIN is entered, this line is all the card shows.
scan.emergencyLabel: Emergency line (chosen by the patient, not encrypted):
scan.pinLocked: Too many wrong PINs. Wait {s} s, then try again, or ask the patient for the PIN.
scan.patientNoId: The QR carries no name and no ID number
scan.noPatientData: Runs on synthetic and GeT-RM reference data; no patient data was used.
